_comment: Where each font's original file comes from (the official source, or the author's chosen distributor such as 猫啃网 when there is no official direct link). 'file' is the Regular weight used for measuring. 'web' lists weights we slice into web fonts ourselves (scripts/slice_webfonts.py), for fonts with no ready-made web version. Files land in fonts-src/ and are never committed or deployed. For archives (.zip/.7z), 'member' is the file inside. 'headers' are sent with the download (猫啃网 needs a Referer). 'instance' cuts one weight out of a variable font, e.g. {"wght": 400}.
